description: Whether each model file computes, per batch item, exactly the output its batch-1 sibling computes on the same provider (bitwise_equal_to_b1: from the stored reference outputs on the 8 reference images or windows, models/references, written by scripts/make_references.py), and, where it does not, whether any prediction changes (predictions_equal_to_b1: top-1 class on ImageNetV2 eval-quick, or anomaly flags on the autoencoder's test split). Keyed by model SHA256, provider and compute precision.

test_split_flags.threshold_rule: max_validation_score of the batch-1 file on the same provider and compute precision; a window is flagged if its score is above it
